units.source_text: 在那棟租屋的二樓，我完全不用掩飾自己平時陰鬱的內心，

en.t: On the second floor of that rented house, I did not have to hide my usual gloomy heart at all,

units.source_text: 像遭受劇烈牙痛一樣捂著臉喝茶。

en.t: and I drank tea with my face in my hand, as if I were suffering from a violent toothache.

units.source_text: 我的這種姿勢反而贏得了她的歡心。

en.t: That posture of mine, if anything, seemed to win her favor.

units.source_text: 她給人的感覺，就像身邊颳著凜冽的寒風，只有落葉飄零著飛舞，是一位完全孤立的女人。

en.t: She gave the impression of a completely isolated woman, as though a bitter cold wind were blowing around her and only fallen leaves were whirling through the air.

units.source_text: 跟她一起躺在床上休息，從其談吐裡得知，她長我兩歲，老家在廣島，她說：

en.t: As I lay resting with her, I learned from the way she talked that she was two years older than me and that her home was in Hiroshima. She said,

units.source_text: 「我有老公呢，原本在廣島開理髮店。

en.t: I have a husband, you know. He used to run a barbershop in Hiroshima.

units.source_text: 去年夏天，我們倆一起私奔到了東京，

en.t: Last summer the two of us ran away together to Tokyo,

units.source_text: 但我老公在東京不做正經工作，

en.t: but my husband did not do honest work in Tokyo,

units.source_text: 之後被判了詐騙罪，現在還在蹲監獄呢。

en.t: and later he was convicted of fraud. He is still in prison now.
